name: place each element at its counted rank
mechanism: for each element count how many are smaller to find its final position, write it there, and continue with the element displaced, so each element is written once

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Cycle sort' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence sorting: in-place with theoretically optimal number of writes

fails_when: quadratic comparisons; optimal only in writes
